name: Gin
description: A clear spirit flavoured mainly with juniper berries plus other botanicals such as coriander, citrus peel and angelica. The base of the Martini, Negroni and Gin and Tonic.

name: London Dry Gin
description: Gin made by redistilling neutral spirit with juniper and other natural botanicals, with nothing but water added afterwards. Dry, juniper forward and the default for most classic gin drinks.

name: Old Tom Gin
description: A lightly sweetened, rounder style of gin popular in the 1800s, sitting between genever and London dry. Called for in the Martinez and the Tom Collins.

name: Navy Strength Gin
description: Gin bottled at about 57% ABV or higher, the strength once supplied to the British Royal Navy. It gives more juniper intensity and body in stirred drinks and tiki style cocktails.

name: Sloe Gin
description: A red liqueur made by steeping sloe berries (blackthorn fruit) in gin with sugar. Tart, plummy and almond tinged, used in the Sloe Gin Fizz and the Charlie Chaplin.

name: Pink Gin
description: Gin flavoured and coloured with red fruit such as strawberry, raspberry or rhubarb, usually lighter in juniper and often a little sweet. Mostly served with tonic, lemonade or in a spritz.

name: Japanese Gin
description: Gin made in Japan, typically with local botanicals such as yuzu, sansho pepper, green tea and cherry blossom alongside juniper. Usually citrus led and delicate.

name: Non-alcoholic Gin
description: An alcohol free spirit alternative made with juniper and other gin botanicals. Used one for one in place of gin for no and low alcohol versions of a Gin and Tonic or other gin drinks.

name: Genever
description: The Dutch and Belgian juniper spirit that gin grew out of, made with a share of malt wine distilled from grain. Malty and rounded, closer to a light whisky than to dry gin.

name: Aquavit
description: A Scandinavian spirit flavoured mainly with caraway or dill, often with fennel, anise and citrus. Drunk chilled with food and used in savoury cocktails in place of gin.

name: Vodka
description: A clear, neutral spirit distilled to high strength from grain, potatoes or other crops, then cut with water. The base for the Espresso Martini, Moscow Mule and Cosmopolitan.

name: Citrus Vodka
description: Vodka flavoured with lemon or other citrus peel, usually unsweetened or close to it. The standard base for a Cosmopolitan and a Lemon Drop.

name: Vanilla Vodka
description: Vodka flavoured with vanilla, often with a touch of sweetness. The base of the Pornstar Martini and a common addition to Espresso Martini variations.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin
description: A juniper heavy London dry gin made with just four botanicals: juniper, coriander, angelica and liquorice. A standard well and Martini gin in bars around the world.

name: Tanqueray No. Ten Gin
description: Tanqueray's small batch gin, distilled with whole fresh grapefruit, orange and lime plus chamomile flowers. Bright and citrus led, widely used for Martinis.

name: Tanqueray Flor de Sevilla Gin
description: A Tanqueray gin flavoured with bittersweet Seville orange and orange blossom. Orange coloured and lightly sweet, mostly poured with tonic or in a spritz.
image_query: Tanqueray Flor de Sevilla Gin bottle

name: Beefeater London Dry Gin
description: A classic London dry gin distilled in Kennington, London, from nine botanicals steeped for 24 hours. Juniper and citrus peel lead, with a dry finish that suits most classic cocktails.

name: Beefeater 24 Gin
description: A Beefeater expression that adds Japanese sencha, Chinese green tea and grapefruit peel to the house botanicals. Softer and more citrus driven than the standard bottling.

name: Beefeater Pink Strawberry Gin
description: Beefeater's London dry gin flavoured with strawberry. Pink, fruity and lightly sweet, made for long drinks with tonic or lemonade.

name: Bombay Sapphire Gin
description: A London dry gin in a blue bottle, made at Laverstoke Mill in Hampshire by passing spirit vapour through ten botanicals. Lighter and more floral than most juniper led gins.

name: Bombay Sapphire Premier Cru Murcian Lemon Gin
description: A higher strength Bombay Sapphire made with Fino lemons, mandarins and sweet oranges from Murcia in Spain. Citrus forward and aimed at Martinis and other stirred drinks.
image_query: Bombay Sapphire Premier Cru Murcian Lemon Gin bottle

name: Gordon's London Dry Gin
description: One of the biggest selling gins in the world, first made in London in 1769. A straightforward juniper led London dry that is a common house pour for a Gin and Tonic.

name: Gordon's Premium Pink Gin
description: Gordon's gin flavoured with strawberry, raspberry and redcurrant. Sweet and berry led, usually served with tonic or lemonade, or topped with sparkling wine.

name: Hendrick's Gin
description: A Scottish gin from Girvan finished with cucumber and rose essences after distillation. Soft and floral, usually served with tonic and a slice of cucumber.

name: Hendrick's Orbium Gin
description: A Hendrick's variant with added quinine, wormwood and blue lotus blossom, borrowing flavours from tonic and vermouth. More bitter and rounder than the original.

name: Hendrick's Flora Adora Gin
description: A Hendrick's release infused with a bouquet of flowers on top of the usual cucumber and rose. Fresh and strongly floral, suited to spritzes and long drinks.

name: Plymouth Gin
description: Made at the Black Friars Distillery in Plymouth since 1793. Softer and earthier than London dry, with less juniper bite and more root botanicals, and a bartender standard for Martinis.

name: Plymouth Navy Strength Gin
description: Plymouth's seven botanical recipe bottled at 57% ABV, the strength once supplied to Royal Navy ships. Richer and more intense, holding up well in a Gimlet or Negroni.

name: Plymouth Sloe Gin
description: Sloe berries steeped in Plymouth gin with a little sugar, based on an 1883 recipe. Tart and fruity with an almond note from the stones, the usual pick for a Sloe Gin Fizz.

name: Sipsmith London Dry Gin
description: A copper pot distilled London dry gin from the Chiswick distillery that helped restart small scale gin making in London in 2009. Classic in style with juniper, lemon and a dry finish.

name: Sipsmith VJOP Gin
description: Very Junipery Over Proof: Sipsmith's gin with extra juniper added at three stages and bottled at 57.7% ABV. Piney and powerful, used where the gin needs to stand out.

name: Sipsmith Sloe Gin
description: Wild sloe berries macerated in Sipsmith London Dry Gin for several months. Less sweet than many sloe gins, with tart plum and cherry flavours.

name: Fords Gin
description: A London dry gin developed by bartender Simon Ford with distiller Charles Maxwell at Thames Distillers. Its nine botanicals are balanced to work across the full range of gin cocktails.

name: Hayman's London Dry Gin
description: A traditional London dry gin from the Hayman family, distillers in London for over 150 years. Ten botanicals give an even mix of juniper, citrus and spice.

name: Hayman's Old Tom Gin
description: A lightly sweetened gin made to a Hayman family recipe from the 1860s. Rounder and richer than London dry, and the most widely stocked Old Tom for a Martinez or Tom Collins.

name: Hayman's Royal Dock Navy Strength Gin
description: Hayman's gin bottled at 57% ABV, named after the Royal Dock at Deptford that supplied the navy. Bold juniper and citrus that carry through dilution in mixed drinks.
image_query: Hayman's Royal Dock Navy Strength Gin bottle

name: Hayman's Sloe Gin
description: English sloe berries steeped for several months in Hayman's gin, then sweetened. Fruity and tart with a plum and almond character, for fizzes or drinking neat.

name: No.3 London Dry Gin
match: No. 3 London Dry Gin (Berry Bros. & Rudd)
description: Created by London wine merchant Berry Bros. & Rudd and distilled in the Netherlands with six botanicals. Crisp juniper, grapefruit peel and cardamom, designed for the Dry Martini.

name: Broker's London Dry Gin
description: A traditional London dry gin made in a copper pot still near Birmingham from ten botanicals, sold with a small bowler hat on the cap. Good value and juniper led.

name: Bulldog London Dry Gin
description: A London dry gin in a dark grey bottle, made with twelve botanicals that include dragon eye, lotus leaf and poppy. Smooth and mild in juniper, often poured with tonic.

name: Boodles London Dry Gin
description: A British gin dating from 1845 that uses no citrus botanicals, relying on juniper with nutmeg, sage and rosemary. Mostly sold in the USA, where it is bottled at 45.2% ABV.

name: Martin Miller's Gin
description: Distilled in England in two separate batches, one for juniper and earthy botanicals and one for citrus, then blended with Icelandic spring water. Soft and citrus bright.

name: Portobello Road London Dry Gin
description: A London dry gin created above a bar on Portobello Road in Notting Hill. Nine botanicals including nutmeg and cassia give a warm, peppery take on the classic style.
image_query: Portobello Road London Dry Gin bottle

name: Jensen's Bermondsey Dry Gin
description: A London dry gin from a small distillery in Bermondsey, modelled on the lighter, smoother gins of the early 1900s. Understated juniper with floral and violet notes.

name: Jensen's Old Tom Gin
description: An Old Tom based on an 1840s recipe, with no added sugar. Its sweetness comes from a heavy load of botanicals, liquorice in particular, giving an earthy, rooty gin.

name: Bathtub Gin
description: A compound gin from Ableforth's, made by steeping juniper, orange peel, coriander, cinnamon, clove and cardamom in spirit rather than redistilling. Lightly tinted and spicy.

name: Tarquin's Cornish Dry Gin
description: A small batch gin distilled in copper pot stills on the north coast of Cornwall. Twelve botanicals, including Devon violets and fresh citrus zest, give a fragrant dry gin.

name: Cotswolds Dry Gin
description: A London dry style gin from the Cotswolds Distillery, made with a large dose of botanicals including local lavender, bay leaf and fresh grapefruit. It turns cloudy with ice or tonic.

name: Hepple Gin
description: A Northumberland gin that combines pot distillation, vacuum distillation and CO2 extraction to capture green juniper, Douglas fir and bog myrtle. Fresh, piney and built for Martinis.

name: Oxley Gin
description: A London dry gin distilled cold under vacuum, which keeps the fresh character of its fourteen botanicals. Bright citrus and soft juniper at a higher bottling strength.
image_query: Oxley Cold Distilled London Dry Gin bottle

name: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin
description: Made at Bruichladdich on Islay, adding 22 hand foraged island botanicals to nine classic ones. Herbal and floral with mint and citrus, and smooth for its strength.
image_query: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin bottle

name: The Botanist Cask Rested Gin
description: The Botanist gin rested for at least six months in a mix of oak cask types at Bruichladdich. Pale gold, with light vanilla and oak layered over the herbal gin.
image_query: The Botanist Cask Rested Gin bottle

name: Caorunn Gin
description: A Speyside gin from Balmenach Distillery made with five Celtic botanicals, including rowan berry, heather and Coul Blush apple. Crisp and lightly fruity, often served with apple.

name: Boatyard Double Gin
description: An organic gin from the shore of Lough Erne in County Fermanagh. The spirit passes through juniper twice, giving a strongly juniper led gin with sweet gale from the family farm.

name: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Irish Gin
description: An Irish gin from County Leitrim distilled with gunpowder green tea, plus citrus that is vapour infused. Fresh and citrusy with a light tea and spice note, in a blue bottle.

name: Citadelle Gin
description: A French gin from Maison Ferrand, distilled over an open flame in Cognac pot stills with 19 botanicals. Juniper forward with citrus and a peppery spice finish.

name: Le Tribute Gin
description: A Spanish gin from a family distillery near Barcelona, with each group of botanicals distilled separately. Strongly citrus led, with lemon, lime, grapefruit, kumquat and lemongrass.

name: Gin Mare
description: A Mediterranean gin from the Spanish coast near Barcelona, distilled with arbequina olives, thyme, rosemary and basil. Savoury and herbal, good with tonic or in a Martini.

name: Nordés Atlantic Galician Gin
description: A gin from Galicia in north west Spain, built on a spirit distilled from Albariño grapes with local herbs such as sea fennel and lemon verbena. Fruity, floral and soft.

name: Malfy Gin Con Limone
description: An Italian gin flavoured with lemons from the Italian coast alongside juniper. Zesty and lightly sweet, mostly used in a Gin and Tonic or a spritz.

name: Malfy Gin Rosa
description: An Italian pink gin flavoured with Sicilian pink grapefruit and rhubarb. Juicy and lightly bitter citrus over a gentle juniper base, made for tonic and spritz serves.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin
description: A Black Forest gin made with 47 botanicals, including local lingonberries and spruce, bottled at 47% ABV. Complex, with citrus, pepper and red fruit over firm juniper.

name: Elephant London Dry Gin
description: A German made London dry gin using African botanicals such as baobab, buchu and devil's claw with fresh apple. Part of the profits go to elephant conservation projects.

name: Nolet's Silver Dry Gin
description: A Dutch gin from the Nolet family distillery in Schiedam, makers of Ketel One. Floral and fruity rather than piney, with Turkish rose, peach and raspberry.

name: Roku Gin
description: Suntory's Japanese craft gin, named for its six Japanese botanicals: sakura flower and leaf, yuzu peel, sencha, gyokuro tea and sansho pepper. Citrus led with a peppery finish.

name: Ki No Bi Kyoto Dry Gin
description: A Kyoto gin built on rice spirit with Japanese botanicals including yuzu, hinoki wood, bamboo leaf, gyokuro tea and sansho. Dry and juniper led with a clear yuzu note.
image_query: Ki No Bi Kyoto Dry Gin bottle

name: Nikka Coffey Gin
description: A Japanese gin based on spirit from Nikka's Coffey column stills, flavoured with yuzu, kabosu, amanatsu and shikuwasa citrus, apple and sansho pepper. Rich texture with bright citrus.

name: Aviation American Gin
description: An American gin from Portland, Oregon, that plays down juniper in favour of lavender, cardamom, sarsaparilla and orange peel. A leading example of the New Western style.

name: St. George Terroir Gin
description: A Californian gin made to taste like the coastal forest, distilled with Douglas fir, California bay laurel and coastal sage. Woody, resinous and strongly aromatic.

name: Bluecoat American Dry Gin
description: A pot distilled gin from Philadelphia made with organic botanicals. American citrus peels lead over a softer juniper, giving a bright, smooth gin in a blue bottle.

name: Junipero Gin
description: A San Francisco gin first released in 1996, one of the first American craft gins. Made in a copper pot still with twelve botanicals, it is bold, dry and heavy on juniper.

name: Barr Hill Gin
description: A Vermont gin made with only juniper and finished with raw northern honey, which adds floral depth and a rounded texture. Used in a Bee's Knees and other sours.

name: Ransom Old Tom Gin
description: An Oregon Old Tom developed with cocktail historian David Wondrich, made on a malted barley base and rested in wine barrels. Amber coloured, malty and lightly spiced.

name: Perry's Tot Navy Strength Gin
description: A navy strength gin from New York Distilling Company in Brooklyn, bottled at 57% ABV. Juniper, citrus peels and spice, with a little upstate New York wildflower honey.
image_query: Perry's Tot Navy Strength Gin bottle

name: Seagram's Extra Dry Gin
description: A long running American gin in a textured bottle and one of the biggest selling gins in the USA. Mild and citrusy with soft juniper, mostly used in simple mixed drinks.

name: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin
description: A Canadian gin from Victoria, British Columbia, coloured deep indigo with butterfly pea blossom. It turns pink when citrus or tonic is added, so it is popular for showy serves.

name: Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin
description: The flagship gin from Healesville in Victoria's Yarra Valley, distilled with whole fresh oranges, Tasmanian pepperberry and lemon myrtle. Citrus and spice over classic juniper.
image_query: Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin bottle

name: Four Pillars Navy Strength Gin
description: Four Pillars' overproof gin at 58.8% ABV, with native finger limes, fresh ginger and turmeric added to the Rare Dry base. Intense and citrusy, made for Gimlets and gin sours.
image_query: Four Pillars Navy Strength Gin bottle

name: Four Pillars Bloody Shiraz Gin
description: Rare Dry Gin steeped for weeks with Victorian Shiraz grapes, released each year. Deep purple, fruity and lightly sweet with no added sugar, in the spirit of a sloe gin.
image_query: Four Pillars Bloody Shiraz Gin bottle

name: Four Pillars Olive Leaf Gin
description: A savoury gin made with olive leaf and cold pressed extra virgin olive oil along with rosemary and bay. Textured and herbal, designed for Martinis and savoury cocktails.
image_query: Four Pillars Olive Leaf Gin bottle

name: Four Pillars Fresh Yuzu Gin
description: A citrus driven gin from Four Pillars distilled with fresh Australian grown yuzu, plus ginger and turmeric. Bright and zesty, suited to highballs and gin sours.
image_query: Four Pillars Fresh Yuzu Gin bottle

name: Never Never Triple Juniper Gin
description: The core gin from Never Never in McLaren Vale, South Australia. Juniper is added three ways (steeped, in the pot and in the vapour basket) for a bold, classic dry gin.
image_query: Never Never Triple Juniper Gin bottle

name: Never Never Southern Strength Gin
description: Never Never's higher proof gin at 52% ABV, using the same triple juniper method with extra citrus and spice. Oily and intense, it stands up well in a Negroni.
image_query: Never Never Southern Strength Gin bottle

name: Never Never Oyster Shell Gin
description: A coastal gin distilled with oyster shells from Kangaroo Island and seaside botanicals, first made with Society restaurant in Melbourne. Briny, mineral and made for Martinis.
image_query: Never Never Oyster Shell Gin bottle

name: Archie Rose Signature Dry Gin
description: A Sydney gin whose botanicals are distilled one by one and then blended, including native blood lime, Dorrigo pepperleaf, lemon myrtle and river mint. Dry, with a juniper backbone.
image_query: Archie Rose Signature Dry Gin bottle

name: Melbourne Gin Company Dry Gin
description: Made at Gembrook Hill in Victoria's Yarra Valley by winemaker Andrew Marks. Eleven botanicals are distilled separately and blended, in a London dry style with local citrus and rosemary.
image_query: Melbourne Gin Company Dry Gin bottle

name: Poor Toms Sydney Dry Gin
description: A gin from Marrickville in Sydney made with fresh green apple, native strawberry gum leaf and chamomile. Light, floral and fruity, and a common pour in Sydney bars.
image_query: Poor Toms Sydney Dry Gin bottle

name: Patient Wolf Melbourne Dry Gin
description: A small batch gin distilled in Southbank, Melbourne. Ruby grapefruit, orange and aniseed myrtle are vapour infused, with tonka bean and cubeb pepper adding a soft spice.
image_query: Patient Wolf Melbourne Dry Gin bottle

name: Hickson Rd. Australian Dry Gin
description: Distilled at Hickson House in The Rocks, Sydney. A London dry framework with oolong tea and the native botanicals finger lime, native thyme and aniseed myrtle.
image_query: Hickson Rd. Australian Dry Gin bottle

name: Manly Spirits Australian Dry Gin
description: A gin from Sydney's Northern Beaches that uses sustainably foraged sea lettuce with native finger lime, anise myrtle and mountain pepperleaf. Fresh, with citrus and a peppery finish.
image_query: Manly Spirits Australian Dry Gin bottle

name: Brookie's Byron Dry Gin
description: Made at Cape Byron Distillery in the Byron Bay hinterland with native rainforest botanicals such as Byron sunrise finger lime, aniseed myrtle and native raspberry. Dry and citrusy.

name: Husk Ink Gin
description: A gin from northern New South Wales coloured deep blue with butterfly pea flower, which turns pink when tonic or citrus is added. Citrus and pepper berry lead the flavour.

name: The West Winds Sabre Gin
description: A Western Australian gin in a London dry mould, with native wattleseed and lemon myrtle plus lime peel. Citrus forward with a toasty note, and a long standing Australian back bar gin.
image_query: The West Winds Gin The Sabre bottle

name: Bellicose Pink Gin
description: An Australian pink gin created by bartender Trish Brew, made with raspberries from Tasmania's Derwent Valley and no added sugar. Dry and juniper forward with a raspberry note.

name: Stranger & Sons Gin
description: An Indian gin distilled in Goa with local botanicals including black pepper, mace, nutmeg, cassia and a mix of Indian citrus peels. Spicy and warm with bright citrus.

name: Hapusa Himalayan Dry Gin
description: An Indian gin made with juniper foraged in the Himalayas, plus turmeric, raw mango, gondhoraj lime and ginger. Earthy and piney with a savoury edge.

name: Canaïma Gin
description: A Venezuelan gin from the makers of Diplomático rum, using Amazonian botanicals such as açaí, copoazú and túpiro alongside juniper. Fruity and tropical, with a dry finish.

name: Ginebra San Miguel
description: A Filipino gin made since 1834 and the biggest selling gin in the world by volume. Light and simple in a Dutch influenced style, drunk neat in shots or mixed with juice.

name: Tanqueray 0.0 Alcohol Free Spirit
description: An alcohol free spirit made by distilling the same four botanicals as Tanqueray London Dry: juniper, coriander, angelica and liquorice. Used for alcohol free Gin and Tonics.

name: Gordon's 0.0 Alcohol Free Spirit
description: An alcohol free version of Gordon's made by distilling its gin botanicals individually and blending them. Juniper led and dry, meant to be mixed with tonic.

name: Smiling Wolf Dry London Non-Alcoholic Gin
match: Smiling Wolf Functional Non Alc Gin
description: A British alcohol free spirit in the London dry style, distilled with juniper, coriander, angelica and citrus peel, with added amino acids and B vitamins. Used in place of gin.
image_query: Smiling Wolf Dry London alcohol free bottle

name: Bols Genever
description: A Dutch genever based on an 1820 Bols recipe, with more than half malt wine distilled from rye, corn and wheat. Malty and smooth, used in classic cocktails of the 1800s.

name: Bols Barrel Aged Genever
description: Bols genever aged for at least 18 months in French Limousin oak. The malt wine base picks up vanilla and wood notes, so it works in stirred drinks where whisky might be used.

name: Old Duff Genever
description: A Dutch genever created by bartender Philip Duff and made in Schiedam, blending malt wine with juniper and a few botanicals. Made with cocktails in mind, malty and lightly citrusy.

name: Rutte Old Simon Genever
description: A genever from the Rutte distillery in Dordrecht, named after its founder. Malt wine is flavoured with juniper, roasted nuts, mace and fruit for a rounded, nutty spirit.

name: Linie Aquavit
description: A Norwegian potato based aquavit flavoured with caraway and aged in oloroso sherry casks that travel by ship across the equator and back. Golden, with caraway, anise and vanilla.

name: Aalborg Taffel Akvavit
description: The classic clear Danish style aquavit, first made in Aalborg in 1846 and now produced in Norway. Strong caraway flavour with a hint of orange, served ice cold with food.

name: Aalborg Jubilæums Akvavit
description: A pale gold aquavit launched in 1946 to mark 100 years of Aalborg Taffel. Flavoured with dill and coriander rather than caraway, it is softer and slightly sweet.

name: O.P. Anderson Aquavit
description: Sweden's best known aquavit, made since 1891 and flavoured with caraway, aniseed and fennel. Briefly matured in oak, it is served chilled with herring and at midsummer.

name: Brennivín
description: Iceland's signature spirit, a clear unsweetened aquavit flavoured with caraway. Clean and savoury, traditionally served ice cold as a shot and now used in cocktails too.

name: Absolut Vodka
description: A Swedish vodka made from winter wheat in Åhus by continuous distillation. Clean with a light grain character, and one of the most widely poured vodkas in the world.

name: Absolut Elyx Vodka
description: Absolut's single estate vodka, made from winter wheat grown on one farm in southern Sweden and distilled in an old copper column still. Silky and full bodied.

name: Absolut Citron Vodka
description: Absolut flavoured with lemon and a touch of lime, with no added sugar. Launched in 1988, it is the vodka most associated with the Cosmopolitan.

name: Absolut Vanilia Vodka
description: Absolut flavoured with natural vanilla, with no added sugar. Rich vanilla with notes of butterscotch, and the usual base for a Pornstar Martini.

name: Absolut Raspberri Vodka
description: Absolut flavoured with raspberry, with no added sugar. Ripe berry aroma on a clean vodka base, used in fruit Martinis and long drinks.

name: Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka
description: The biggest selling vodka brand in the world, triple distilled from grain and filtered through charcoal. Neutral and clean, a standard well vodka. Sold at 37.5% ABV in some markets.

name: Grey Goose Vodka
description: A French vodka made from soft winter wheat grown in Picardy and blended with spring water in the Cognac region. Smooth and rounded with a faint sweetness.

name: Grey Goose Le Citron Vodka
description: Grey Goose flavoured with the oils of French lemons. Fresh lemon zest on a soft wheat vodka base, used in Cosmopolitans, Lemon Drops and vodka sodas.
image_query: Grey Goose Le Citron Vodka bottle

name: Ketel One Vodka
description: A Dutch wheat vodka from the Nolet family distillery in Schiedam, which blends column distilled spirit with a portion from copper pot stills. Crisp, with a lively, silky feel.

name: Ketel One Citroen Vodka
description: Ketel One infused with the essence of lemons and limes. Zesty and dry with a little natural sweetness, widely used by bartenders for Cosmopolitans.

name: Belvedere Vodka
description: A Polish vodka distilled from Dankowskie rye at the Polmos Żyrardów distillery, with no additives. Full and creamy with vanilla and a hint of white pepper.

name: Tito's Handmade Vodka
description: A corn based vodka made in Austin, Texas, using pot stills. Slightly sweet and smooth, it is the top selling spirit in the USA and a common call vodka.

name: Stoli Vodka
description: Formerly labelled Stolichnaya, a wheat and rye vodka produced in Riga, Latvia, and filtered through quartz sand and charcoal. Clean with a light grain and pepper note.

name: Stoli Elit Vodka
description: The top expression from Stoli, made in Latvia and chilled to a very low temperature before filtration to remove impurities. Soft and clean, mostly used for Martinis or neat.

name: Haku Vodka
description: Suntory's Japanese vodka, made from 100% white rice and filtered through bamboo charcoal. Soft and subtly sweet with a clean finish, suited to highballs and Martinis.

name: Nikka Coffey Vodka
description: A Japanese vodka from Nikka, blending corn and barley spirits distilled in the company's Coffey column stills and filtered with white birch charcoal. Creamy with a light sweetness.

name: Reyka Vodka
description: An Icelandic vodka made in small batches in Borgarnes on a Carter Head still, using glacial spring water and filtered through lava rock. Crisp and clean with a smooth finish.

name: Wyborowa Vodka
description: A Polish rye vodka made since 1927 and one of the country's best known exports. Slightly sweet, nutty rye character, and a common well vodka in European bars.

name: Finlandia Vodka
description: A Finnish vodka distilled from six row barley and blended with untreated glacial spring water. Light and dry with a crisp finish, sold widely around the world.

name: Eristoff Vodka
description: A grain vodka with Georgian roots, now owned by Bacardi and produced in southern France. Triple distilled and charcoal filtered, it is a common house vodka in Europe and Australia.

name: Altamura Distilleries Vodka
description: An Italian vodka from Puglia made only from Altamura durum wheat, the grain used for the region's protected bread. Triple distilled, full bodied and lightly savoury.

name: Never Never Signature Vodka
description: The first vodka from Never Never in South Australia, made from Australian wheat spirit enriched with olive, coconut and avocado oils, then carbon filtered. Textured and smooth.

name: Boatyard Vodka
description: An organic wheat vodka from County Fermanagh in Northern Ireland, distilled three times and bottled without filtration. Rich and creamy with a peppery, vanilla finish.

name: Archie Rose True Cut Vodka
description: A vodka from Sydney distillery Archie Rose, part of its Fundamental Spirits range made for bartenders. Clean and neutral with a soft texture, designed for mixing.
image_query: Archie Rose True Cut Vodka bottle

name: Zubrowka Bison Grass Vodka
description: A Polish rye vodka flavoured with bison grass from the Białowieża Forest, with a blade in each bottle. Herbal, with vanilla and almond notes, and often mixed with apple juice.

name: Chopin Potato Vodka
description: A Polish vodka made from potatoes grown near the family distillery in Krzesk. Creamy and full bodied with an earthy note, and a reference point for potato vodka.

name: Luksusowa Vodka
description: A Polish potato vodka produced since 1928. Smooth and slightly creamy with a clean finish, and an affordable option for bars that want a potato based vodka.

name: Konik's Tail Vodka
description: A Polish vodka made from three grains (spelt, golden rye and early winter wheat) and created by Pleurat Shabani. Nutty and rounded, a favourite for Martinis in London bars.

name: Potocki Vodka
description: A Polish rye vodka tied to the Potocki family's distilling history at Łańcut. Distilled twice and left unfiltered, it keeps a rich, oily rye character.

name: Cîroc Vodka
description: A French vodka distilled from grapes rather than grain, with the final distillation in a copper pot still. Smooth with a faint citrus and fruit character.

name: Skyy Vodka
description: An American grain vodka launched in San Francisco in 1992 and sold in a cobalt blue bottle. Clean and neutral, and a common well vodka in bars in the USA and Australia.

name: Russian Standard Original Vodka
description: A Russian vodka from St Petersburg made from winter wheat and water from Lake Ladoga, filtered through charcoal. Clean with a slightly sweet bread note.

name: 42 Below Vodka
description: A New Zealand wheat vodka distilled several times and blended with spring water. Clean and soft, and a common pour in Australian and New Zealand bars.

name: Vodka O
description: An Australian vodka that is triple distilled and widely used as a house pour in Australian bars and clubs. Neutral and clean, meant for mixing rather than sipping.

name: Svedka Vodka
description: A Swedish winter wheat vodka distilled in a continuous column process. Light and neutral, and one of the top selling imported vodkas in the USA.

name: New Amsterdam Vodka
description: A Californian grain vodka distilled five times and filtered three times. Neutral and soft, and a common low cost well vodka in the USA.

name: Hangar 1 Vodka
description: A Californian vodka from Alameda that blends spirit distilled from grapes with grain spirit. Lightly floral and fruity, with more character than most neutral vodkas.

name: Wheatley Vodka
description: A wheat vodka made in small batches at Buffalo Trace Distillery in Kentucky and named after master distiller Harlen Wheatley. Clean and crisp with a soft vanilla note.

name: Crystal Head Vodka
description: A Canadian vodka from Newfoundland sold in a glass skull bottle. Made from corn with no additives and filtered through Herkimer diamond crystals, it is smooth and faintly sweet.

name: Black Cow Pure Milk Vodka
description: An English vodka from West Dorset made from the whey left over from cheese making on a dairy farm. Notably creamy in texture with a clean, slightly sweet finish.

name: Discarded Grape Skin Chardonnay Vodka
description: A vodka made from wine industry leftovers: Chardonnay grape skins, stems and seeds, blended with alcohol recovered from dealcoholised wine. Fruity with a light grape note.
